name: showreel-c3-marathon

voice.text: Why is a marathon 42.195 kilometres? The first Olympic marathon, 1896: about 40 kilometres. Then the distance kept changing. Until London, 1908. It ran from Windsor Castle to the royal box in the stadium. That's 26 miles 385 yards: 42.195 kilometres. In 1921, it became the official distance. Turns out, every marathon runs London's 1908 course.

caption:
A marathon is 42.195 km (26.2 miles) because of one race: London, 1908, from Windsor Castle to the royal box. 🏃👑

Send this to the friend running their first marathon. 👇
